title: AI chat: a message sent from a conversation link before the conversation finishes loading may be dropped (seen in a test harness, unconfirmed)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: a `finding` for triage, unmeasured mechanism. Observed by the developer of PR #33561 (#33420) while building a CONTROL pin (report 6886717406, Acceptance notes, last bullet), not chased.

## What was seen

In the rendered `AiChatPage` harness, on a deep link to an existing conversation (`/ai/build/conv-7`), a message submitted before that conversation's GET answered was not sent within 4 s: no chat POST, the composer was cleared, and nothing was queued. If this holds in a real browser, the user's typed text is lost when they send right after opening a conversation link.

## What is needed

- Reproduce in the running console (throttle `GET /conversations/:id`, send at once) and read the mechanism in `useChatConversation` / `useDeferredFirstSend` (`ui/packages/app-shell`).
- If confirmed: grade it, and the fix holds or replays the send once the conversation is open. If not: close with the reading.
